name: Layton Kyouju VS Gyakuten Saiban
original_name: レイトン教授VS逆転裁判
source:
In the city of London, a young girl named Espella Cantabella is chased after by a mysterious force and seeks the aid of Professor Layton and his assistant, Luke Triton. When Espella is suddenly captured, Layton's investigation leads him to a strange book which transports him and Luke to a strange medieval city known as Labyrinthia. This town is allegedly home to witches who hides in the shadows, and is controlled by someone called the Story Teller, who allegedly has the power to turn anything he writes into reality. Meanwhile, Phoenix Wright and his assistant, Maya Fey, who have traveled to London on business, encounter the same book and are also transported to Labyrinthia. There, they discover Espella has been accused of being a witch and is to be put on trial. As Phoenix decides to defend Espella, soon discovering that the laws of this world are far different from his own, Layton seeks to solve the mystery behind Labyrinthia, with the two not always seeing eye to eye.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Professor_Layton_vs._Phoenix_Wright:_Ace_Attorney]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
在倫敦，一名叫瑪荷妮．卡塔路西亞的少女遭到神秘勢力追趕，向雷頓教授和助手路克．特雷頓求助。瑪荷妮突然被捕後，雷頓的調查將他引向一本奇怪的書。這本書把他和路克帶到一座名為迷宮城的中世紀城市。傳說這裡有隱藏在暗處的女巫，而城市由一名叫「說書人」的人統治，據說他能讓自己寫下的一切變成現實。與此同時，因公務來到倫敦的成步堂龍一和助手綾里真宵也遇到了同一本書，並被傳送到迷宮城。在那裡，他們發現瑪荷妮被控為女巫，即將受審。成步堂決定為瑪荷妮辯護，卻很快發現這個世界的法律與自己的世界大不相同；雷頓則著手解開迷宮城背後的謎團。兩人並不總是意見一致。

［譯自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Professor_Layton_vs._Phoenix_Wright:_Ace_Attorney]維基百科[/url]］
